research_leads.question: Document the direct family line connecting Gheorghe Cican, Margareta Cican, Vasile Cican and George-Alin Cican.
research_leads.what_would_prove_it: Independent civil, parish, archival or other reliable records establishing each relevant relationship.

research_leads.question: Identify and document the historical Cican occurrences associated with Căpățâneni and the wider Curtea de Argeș area.
research_leads.what_would_prove_it: Dated archival, parish, civil, property, military, newspaper or other reliable historical records.

research_leads.question: Investigate the earliest defensible documentary occurrences of Cican and relevant variants globally.
research_leads.what_would_prove_it: Original or reliably cited dated documentary evidence, with source provenance and independent verification where possible.
